criterion.image_only: IntentDiT (S_L, training seed 1) with Type-F1 >= 0.85, between n_gt and n_gt + 1 elements, at least 70% of the designer's total box area, Ove <= 0.02, OOB = 0, and occlusion at least 0.03 below both LayoutDiT outputs; final choice among the ranked candidates by visual clarity.
criterion.prompt_control: Free-form prompts for which IntentDiT given the element list (training seed 1) reproduces the manual reference counts exactly and places every requested element in its requested cell; ranked by raw-instruction SPLA and exact count, the SPLA margin over PosterO given the same list, and occlusion; final choice by visual clarity.
